scope: Ground-energy algorithm motivation;first pilot would test molecular primitive semantics and resource feasibility,not establish final QPE benefit.
decision_needed_before_launch: GPT judgement whether a distinct accuracy/construction contribution justifies closing the arithmetic backend and preparing a fixed pilot. Review start is separate authorization.

input_policy.origin: Fresh integrals only after explicit authorization;existing snapshot reuse requires coefficient,basis,mode,constant,DF identity checks.
input_policy.independence: H4 1.00 Angstrom already used in project development;not held-out. H2 cannot alone support generality.
input_policy.integrals: real RHF molecular orbitals,normal-ordered exact one/two body,all signed terms kept
input_policy.DF_rank_policy: full supplied decomposition with reconstructed coefficient equality;no model truncation or rank-scan in first pilot
input_policy.steps_and_windows: Future candidate h=0.25/0.125/0.0625 in atomic time;T=1 diagnostic. These are design candidates,not evaluated or execution-frozen inputs.
input_policy.nuclear_and_scalar_phases: retain and charge in controlled wrapper

baseline_design: DF-native S2/S4 using identical original H
known compressed conditional-SU2/arithmetic relative block;give it the same cancellation and precision optimizations
comparison_rule: Permit each method its own admissible step count/order at equal total deterministic error and identical outputs. Never treat a weak global-A implementation as sole baseline.
future_outputs: coefficient identity and counts/supports/detuning coefficient lengths
full-Fock operator checks and clean workspace/control semantics of compiled primitive
native RZ/CX/depth/ancilla and logical T/Toffoli at the same precision
required-step/cost break-even conditions;ground-energy branch information diagnostic only

future_energy_connection.unitary: Fix one approximate seed S(h) and use its powers for phase estimation. Independently approximated times need a separate estimator/branch argument.
future_energy_connection.state_preparation: RHF as common available trial state;preparation costs charged,ground overlap not assumed or free.
future_energy_connection.qualification: Candidates for later adoption;no method currently certifies these goals. Alias interval/time grid,overlap/branch and estimator must close before any energy-task execution.
future_energy_connection.no_free_ground_truth: FCI/true gap may be post-hoc reference only,not generator or candidate-selector inputs.

STOP: No concrete method delta or relevant common-quality benefit beyond known constructor.
Exponentially many occupation or b-bit table entries assumed free.
Precision/control/uncompute invalid or actual access cost defeats admissible step savings.
Resource call/memory/output caps or evidence identity fails.
forbidden_in_current_task: PR/THRIFT hybrid moment or sampling experiments.
compile_design_accounting: Upper cap 2 molecules ×7 method rows (native S2/S4,DF S2/S4,global-A THRIFT,known compressed arithmetic,candidate) ×3 h ×4 powers q=1/2/4/8 =168. Identical known/candidate rows may only share with required identity checks in a future frozen contract.
